about_the_game:
Claritas RPG - Extra Hero Pack 3


Unlock four powerful new heroes and expand your strategic options in battle! Each hero brings unique abilities and playstyles to enhance your party in new and exciting ways.

Sea Hag

The Sea Hag, a formidable witch, wields unparalleled mastery over the seas and weather. Revered by sailors and fishermen, she is honored with offerings as they seek her blessings for safe voyages and bountiful catches.

Attributes:
Strength: 20 + 2 per Level
Intelligence: 60 + 6 per Level
Dexterity: 40 + 4 per Level

Skills:
Splash: Blasts the enemy with water, damaging and soaking them, decreasing cold/lightning resistances.
Healing Breeze: The breeze heals your allies every turn.
Wave Crash: Summons a mighty water wave, damaging and soaking all enemies.
Tempest: Invokes a powerful tempest, dealing heavy cold and lightning damage over two turns.

Orc Champion

Orcs value physical prowess above everything. The Champion doesn't receive this title for nothing—he is simply the strongest warrior of his tribe and revels in savagely killing his enemies.

Attributes:
Strength: 70 + 7 per Level
Intelligence: 20 + 2 per Level
Dexterity: 30 + 3 per Level

Skills:
Greatsword: Deals slash damage and decreases slash resistance.
Cleaving Sword: Passively makes single-target skills damage other enemies.
War Cry: Shields your allies and increases their damage and defense.
Devastating Strike: Deals massive damage and can ignore defense.

Gladiator

The only warrior to survive the brutal Colosseum, he relied on unmatched skill and battle prowess to kill his opponents one by one. When the ferocious beast was unleashed to kill him, he vanquished it with a flurry of precise, deadly strikes, leaving the crowd in awe.

Attributes:
Strength: 30 + 3 per Level
Intelligence: 20 + 2 per Level
Dexterity: 70 + 7 per Level

Skills:
Short Sword: A quick slashing attack.
Parry: Gives a chance to block and counter enemy attacks.
Blood Bath: Grants critical strike chance and heals on critical hits.
Omnislash: Strikes random enemies multiple times, gaining extra hits per critical strike.

Goblin Bomber

Crazy and ingenious, this goblin spends most of his time crafting and tinkering with explosives so that, one day, he might fulfill his lifelong quest of blowing up the entire world!

Attributes:
Strength: 20 + 2 per Level
Intelligence: 50 + 5 per Level
Dexterity: 50 + 5 per Level

Skills:
Fire Trap: Sets a fire trap that damages the enemy who triggers it.
Rapid Deployment: Passively decreases the AP cost of trap skills.
Chain Reaction: Detonates all traps and increases their damage.
Nuclear Bomb: Sets a nuclear trap that deals massive damage and causes radiation poisoning.

Add these heroes to your roster today and forge new legends in battle!
